latestVersion.changelog:
openclaw-threadsctl 1.0.3

- Added support and workflow guidance for publishing Threads carousel (multi-photo) posts and media spoilers.
- Updated documentation to include `publish carousel`, multi-image file/url options, and the `--spoiler` flag for eligible media.
- Clarified media rules for carousel vs. single-image posts and handling of spoilers in carousels.
- Improved skill description and use-case coverage.
- Removed the outdated `examples.md` file; all scenarios are now included directly in the main documentation.
